itens.trecho: Um filme excelente, emocionante com uma boa história. Vale a pena ver. Este filme resulta da adaptação de uma trilogia literária da autoria de Suzanne Collins. Não os li, não faço particular intenção de o fazer por nenhuma razão em especial, pelo que vou ignorar os livros e focar-me no filme. E o que tenho a dizer é bastante positivo.

Stories about revolution can be quite good. But stories about why a revolution is needed are invariably great. The Hunger Games is such a story. The movie (for the most part), closely follows the book, and does a good job of it. It also sets up the next book/movie beautifully, even better than the book itself does.

I had not really bothered to put this movie on my to-watch shelf since I felt it was not really my cup of tea but when my wife and oldest son wondered why we did not have it in our collection I thought, well, okay let us get it then. Actually I got the set with the two movies that have been released and yesterday we watched the first one.
